name: Touch FX
author: mrdjjag
summary: Touch FX for prepared STEMS and sampler, with adaptive layouts and custom touch controls.
description: Custom-build beta for XDJ-AZ. Requires matching customised azmod.so and azstem.so; the .azmod alone is not a complete installation. STEMS Touch FX requires tracks separated using Kyle's AZ-MODS Mod Manager, with STEMS enabled on the selected deck. Sampler uses its own samples. See the source repository for firmware compatibility, build and developer-mode installation requirements.
